notes.title: Community Songs Update
notes.content:
[b]Big Update for Taiko Frenzy![/b]

Community Songs are now fully integrated into the game! Easily browse, explore, and download songs created by players worldwide—jump right into the amazing creations the community has to offer!  

[previewyoutube=OEyhIwCGlBs;full][/previewyoutube]

🎵 *All custom songs are sourced from the Taiko Frenzy page on mod.io.*  
Want to share your own masterpieces? Head to our mod.io page: [url=https://mod.io/g/taiko-frenzy/]mod.io Game Page[/url] 

Check out the [b]Guides[/b] section to learn how to create custom songs and share them with the world. With these tools, we’re excited to see the community’s creativity flourish!  

To celebrate this exciting update, Taiko Frenzy is part of the Autumn Sales, enjoy a fantastic [b]30% discount[/b] and dive into the game now!

✨ Don’t forget to join our Discord to share your thoughts, feedback, or just say hi: [url=https://discord.gg/mBWfpkcgAj]Discord Community Server[/url]  

Let’s keep drumming, and have fun! 🥁

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.content:
Exciting news for the community: Taiko Frenzy now has an official page on mod.io! You can check it out here: [url=https://mod.io/g/taiko-frenzy]mod.io Taiko Frenzy[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4pwprb9.png[/img]

This page is the go-to spot for sharing and downloading custom songs. You’ll also find helpful guides on creating your own custom tracks using the TF Editor!

We’ve also updated both the game and TF Editor to simplify the custom song installation process. Now, you can easily drag and drop zip files into the correct folder to install your favorite tracks. Learn more here: [url=https://mod.io/g/taiko-frenzy/r/install-and-play-custom-songs]Install and play custom songs[/url].

If you’d like to share your creations with the community, it's easy to do! Follow this guide: [url=https://mod.io/g/taiko-frenzy/r/upload-your-custom-song]Upload your custom song[/url].

We hope you enjoy these improvements! This is just the beginning—we’re working on adding an in-game song browser UI in future updates, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Pause Menu: Resolved an issue where the game could not be unpaused in specific situations after the application was put in background.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Taiko Frenzy is taking part of the Steam Rhythm Fest this year so now is the perfect time to get your hands on the game with a nice 20% discount.

It's the occasion for us to release our new update with a couple of fixes and new features for the game and the song editor!

[h1]Game updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Spanish language support: all the game has been translated into Spanish
[*] Custom song new features support: start offset and floating BPM
[*] Bug fix and optimizations for Services connection 
[*] Bug fix for currency not being gained in certain conditions
[*] Bug fix for UI animations not playing at the correct framerate
[*] Bug fix for inventory equipment not correctly applied between launches
[/list]

[h1]TF Editor updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Beatsaber map parsing optimizations
[*] osu! taiko map parsing optimizations
[*] Floating BPM support, you can now set BPM with decimals. It also works for BPM Events.
[*] Start offset support
[*] Track scan: when you open a project, your track will be scanned to detect potential issues (like overlapping notes) and fix it
[*] BPM Event time signature: you can now set the amount of beats per bar for each BPM Event
[*] Bug fix for BPM Events that broke the grid generation / notes timings
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] LIV integration: You can now use LIV to capture game footages in mixed reality and stabilized FPV
[*] UI tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: Taiko Frenzy is now available on Steam
notes.content:
After 18 months of work, Glitchr Studio is proud to announce that version 1.0 of Taiko Frenzy has finally arrived.

[h2]WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM THE GAME[/h2]
[list]
[*] 20 original soundtracks available on several progressive difficulty levels
[*] A stunning handpainted environment inspired by Japanese Folklore with cute little creatures (Kodama) interacting with the music
[*] An accessible On Boarding for new comers and rhythm game veterans
[*] A progression system that rewards your performance with over 100 unlockable cosmetics (sticks, charms, taiko skins...)
[*] A custom song support with dedicated editor tool to play your favourite songs directly in the game
[*] Game modifiers to adjust song difficulties to your liking
[*] A complete scoring system with multipliers and active boost mechanics (recognized by gesture) to optimize your climb in Worldwide Leaderboards
[*] Over 60 achievements to unlock
[/list]

We are thrilled to start building a community for the game on Steam. We can't wait to get your feedbacks. If you want to chat, you can join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/mBWfpkcgAj]Discord server[/url].

Have fun and see you soon for new adventures!
